title: Tribal Fusion Bellydance Choreography class by Olga Meos / Amanati Pythia

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher explains the movements in both English and Russian, alternating between the two languages. She focuses on the feeling of the movement, using imagery to help students understand the flow and quality of the dance.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces the class and the music.
The teacher leads a warmup focusing on hip and torso movements.
The teacher breaks down the snake-like movements of the torso and arms.
The teacher explains how to incorporate the legs into the movement.
The teacher demonstrates how to use the fingers and arms to create a wave-like effect.

extraction.counting_scheme: the teacher does not use a formal counting scheme, instead f
cues: Make a little bit space between feet
Make some groovy in your chest
Try to find in your spine
Make the snake finish on your arms
metaphors: hips and pelvic is the bowl
snake which is traveling in your body
common_mistakes: Trying to copy the teacher exactly instead of feeling the movement
safety: No yoga blocks or mats needed

steps_taught.name: Hip shifts
steps_taught.description: Shifting the hips in different directions to create a groove.

steps_taught.name: Torso snake
steps_taught.description: A fluid, wave-like movement of the torso.

steps_taught.name: Arm snake
steps_taught.description: A fluid, wave-like movement of the arms.

steps_taught.name: Finger wave
steps_taught.description: A wave-like movement of the fingers and arms.

what_works: The teacher's use of imagery and focus on the feeling of the movement makes it easy to understand.
The breakdown of the movements into smaller, more manageable parts is helpful.
what_hinders: The lack of a formal counting scheme might make it difficult for some students to keep track of the rhythm.

quotes.text: Start to move your hips in different directions.
Make some groovy in your chest.
Try to find in your spine like snake which is traveling in your body.
And give the snake to the legs.
I want to make the wave with the fingers.
